caption: The drawing shows a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, with the seat facing slightly to the right. The chair has four legs, a rounded seat, and a curved backrest supported by four vertical spindles. The wood is illustrated in shades of light brown, with hints of green and red, giving a natural, textured appearance. The legs are connected by horizontal stretchers, providing stability to the structure. The chair is centered within a roughly rectangular frame drawn on an off-white background, and there are no other objects or decorations present in the composition. Shadows beneath the legs of the chair are lightly rendered in gray, indicating the direction of light.
title: Kitchen Chair
